# Helvety Docs

> Edit .docx files in the browser. Local editing needs no account. Optional vault save encrypts document titles and file bytes on your device before storage.

## Canonical URL
- [Helvety Docs](https://helvety.com/docs): Browser-based Word (.docx) editor

## Crawling And Indexing
- The main editor route is intended to be indexable.
- API and auth callback routes are not intended as crawl targets.

## Related Helvety Apps
- [Helvety](https://helvety.com)

## Licensing
All Helvety products with published source are released under AGPL-3.0 or later (including browser extensions, SharePoint solutions, and desktop tools distributed outside this repository). The embedded docx editor library (@eigenpal/docx-editor-react) is Apache-2.0.
